title: Python modules: conditional try/except from-import whose source ends in an external star reports unresolved star-import
description: S3 (GCLI-75) Opus delta non-blocking 1: the conservative reading after the starOnly fix; decide whether a try/except arm over a partial star should be multiply-bound or stay unresolved. Also state the limit that a top-level testing/ package is never a guard root (comment only today at modules.ts).

acceptanceCriteria.text: the behaviour for a conditional from-import over a partial star is decided and pinned by a test
the testing/ guard-root limit is documented where S7 will read it
